# DOC fixtures

`word-table.doc` and `word-revisions.doc` are `test12.doc` and `test01.doc` from [morungos/node-word-extractor](https://github.com/morungos/node-word-extractor/tree/develop/__tests__/data), distributed under the MIT license included in `word-extractor-LICENSE.txt`.

They exercise a real Word 97–2003 container, table text, Unicode, and tracked revisions. Other test documents are generated during the test run.
